role: @Observable @MainActor cache holding the current training metrics (CTL/ATL/TSB/ACWR) and a 400-day day-by-day ATL/CTL/TRIMP series, refreshed from HealthKit + an injected session-archive source and settings closure, and persisted to an injected snapshot file sealed with an injected seal (the app's: Application Support, the app's key) for cold-launch display.
types: TrainingMetricsCache: class (@Observable @MainActor final) — shared training-load cache read by dashboard, Fitness tab, trajectory loader and AI fact resolvers
TrainingMetricsCache.DaySample: struct Codable — one day's atl/ctl/trimp (+computed tsb)
TrainingMetricsCache.PersistedCache: struct Codable (internal, for tests through writeSnapshot/readSnapshot) — on-disk snapshot shape
state: static let shared = TrainingMetricsCache() (mem:TrainingMetricsCache.shared, the app's instance on the default sources; returned by AnalysisServices.trainingMetricsCache)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.archiveSource (@Sendable () -> SessionArchive; the app's resolves AppDependencies.current.storage.sessionArchive at each read)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.persistenceURL (URL?, the snapshot file; nil keeps nothing on disk) and mem:TrainingMetricsCache.seal (JSONFileSeal)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.lastUpdated (Date?, when the last compute was published; nil = dirty flag)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.computedAt (Date?, when current was computed or restored; never cleared by invalidate — the 'as of' stamp)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.historicalBuildPending (Bool, a series build started and not yet adopted)
mem:TrainingMetricsCache.persistTask (latest disk write; the next one awaits it)

file:Application Support/TrainingMetricsCache.json (static defaultPersistenceURL, the app's snapshot file; JSON sealed with the app's key — plain JSON from builds that did not seal it still opens; .atomic + completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers only: dailySeries = [:], historicalBuildPending = false, lookbackDays 400, replayWarmUpDays 180, observers = NotificationTokens(), static defaultPersistenceURL closure. Imports CryptoKit for SHA-256 fingerprinting.

units.does: Computed TSB of a DaySample: ctl - atl.

Stores the archive source, settings closure, snapshot URL and seal (defaults: the archive and settings of AppDependencies.current read at each use, defaultPersistenceURL, JSONFileSeal.app), restores the snapshot at that URL via loadFromDisk, then registers an archive-change observer whose callback runs invalidateIfWorkoutsChanged on the main actor. `shared` is built with the defaults; a test builds one from its own archive, settings and file.
Adds a NotificationCenter block observer for .flowRecoveryArchiveChanged on queue nil; each post schedules Task @MainActor running the passed closure. Returns the token.
calls: closure:onChange — set by init to invalidateIfWorkoutsChanged

units.does: SHA-256 hex digest over 'sessionId:fileHash\n' for every entry of the archive source's archive with sessionType == .workout, sorted by sessionId string. Reads only the in-memory archive index.

branches.effect: appends its id:fileHash line to the digest; no workouts → digest of empty input

units.does: Recomputes the workout fingerprint; when it differs from lastWorkoutFingerprint stores it and calls invalidate() (lastUpdated = nil).
units.entry: Observer callback for .flowRecoveryArchiveChanged (via makeArchiveObserver, scheduled on MainActor).

branches.effect: true: return, nothing invalidated (HRV-only writes ignored); false: store fingerprint and invalidate

units.does: deinit: removes all NotificationCenter observers held in observers.
units.entry: Swift deinit; never runs in practice because the instance is a static singleton.

units.does: Static lazy initializer for the app's snapshot file: Application Support directory (created if missing) + 'TrainingMetricsCache.json'; nil if FileManager throws (logged through attempt). The default persistenceURL of the init.
units.entry: Static stored-property initializer, evaluated on first use as the init's default argument.

branches.effect: true: nil → a cache built with it keeps nothing on disk; false: returns dir/TrainingMetricsCache.json

units.does: Snapshots current, dailySeries, fingerprint ('' if nil), computedDay, savedAt (= computedAt) and loadSettings, then in a detached utility task that first awaits the previous write (persistTask) writes it sealed with the cache's seal (writeSnapshot) to the cache's persistenceURL, so snapshots land in the order they were taken; a failure (no key reachable to seal among them) writes nothing, keeps the previous file and is logged as a warning. Nothing is written before the first compute (computedAt nil) or without a persistenceURL.

branches.effect: true: return without writing; false: continue
fingerprint stored as '' (never equals a real digest, so next launch sees an observed change)
awaited before this one starts
error logged at .warning; previous file kept (next cold launch rebuilds from it or from scratch)

units.does: Encodes the snapshot (JSONEncoder), seals it with the seal (the app's key by default) and writes it atomically to the URL with completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication. Throws the encode, seal (no key reachable) or write error, having written nothing.
units.entry: Called by persistToDisk's detached task; tests call it on a temporary file.

units.does: Nil when no file is at the URL; otherwise reads it, opens it with the seal (sealed bytes decrypted; plain JSON from builds that did not seal it passed through) and decodes a PersistedCache. Throws the read, open (the key locked among them) or decode error.
units.entry: Called by loadFromDisk; tests call it on a temporary file.

branches.effect: nil

units.does: Reads the snapshot at the cache's persistenceURL opened with its seal (readSnapshot) and restores current, dailySeries, fingerprint, computedDay, loadSettings, lastUpdated and computedAt (both = saved timestamp); logs the restore. No URL or no file restores nothing silently; a file that cannot be read, opened or decoded is logged (attempt) and restores nothing, so the cache starts cold and its first write replaces the file.

branches.cond: URL nil, no file, or read/open/decode throws (logged)
branches.effect: true: return, cache stays cold; false: state restored

Async refresh: no-op without a configured HealthKitManager or when needsRebuild is false; if a refresh task is in flight awaits it; otherwise starts a refresh task and awaits it.

return; cached result reused

units.does: Computes whether the cached result may be out of date and delegates to the static rule: observedChange = the archive source's workout fingerprint differs from lastWorkoutFingerprint; dayChanged = the reference day differs from lastComputedDay; settingsChanged = the load settings from the settings closure differ from lastLoadSettings; hasResult = current != nil && (dailySeries non-empty || a series build is pending), so refreshes during a cold series build don't restart it. Internal so a test can check it against the sources it built the cache from.
Builds LoadSettings from the UserSettings the settings closure returns (resting/max HR, sex, FTPs).

Captures current LoadSettings, creates a Task that runs recompute when self and healthKit still exist; if healthKit has gone nil the task releases its refreshTask registration (unless cancelled) so a later refresh can start; stores the task in refreshTask and returns it.

branches.effect: task returns
releaseRefreshTaskUnlessCancelled, return; else runs recompute

units.does: Clears refreshTask from inside the running refresh task unless that task was cancelled (rebuildFromScratch has then registered its own).

branches.effect: true: leave refreshTask alone; false: nil it

units.does: Records the archived-workout fingerprint the compute starts from and fetches HealthKit workouts for 580 days (400 + 180 warm-up) with fetchWorkoutsExtendedIfAnswered. A query that failed or timed out publishes nothing: it logs a warning and releases the refresh registration unless cancelled, so the published result, the series and the disk snapshot stay as they were and the next refresh asks again. Otherwise resolves HR anchors once, computes TrainingMetrics with those preloaded workouts and, unless cancelled, publishes current with the starting fingerprint (publishCurrent leaves the result dirty if the workouts changed meanwhile) and starts the historical rebuild if its key changed.

branches.cond: the HealthKit workout query failed or timed out (nil)
branches.effect: logs a warning and releases refreshTask unless cancelled; nothing published or persisted
return without publishing anything; else publish and maybe start historical build

units.does: Stamps what the compute reflects: computedAt = now; lastUpdated = now only if the archived-workout fingerprint still equals the one the compute started from, else nil (dirty: a workout was archived mid-compute, so the next refresh recomputes); lastWorkoutFingerprint = the starting fingerprint; lastComputedDay = startOfDay(reference); lastLoadSettings; clears refreshTask; persists to disk.

branches.cond: fingerprint unchanged since the compute started
branches.effect: true: lastUpdated = now (clean); false: lastUpdated = nil (dirty)

units.does: Builds HistoricalKey from archive fingerprint, HealthKit workout fingerprint, startOfDay(reference), settings and anchors.

Starts a build when the key changed, or when the series is empty and no build is pending: records the key, marks a build pending, resolves the archive source's archive on the main actor and starts a detached utility task that replays 580 days over it, keeps the last 400 and hands the result to adoptHistoricalSeries. A refresh during a pending cold build with the same key starts nothing.

branches.cond: key unchanged and (series non-empty or a build pending)
branches.effect: return, existing series or pending build reused; else rebuild

units.does: Adopts a finished series only if its key is still the latest (clearing historicalBuildPending), then persists.

branches.effect: discard (newer build started); else adopt and persist

units.does: Awaits the current historicalTask if one exists.

branches.effect: await its value; else return immediately

units.does: Filters series to keys >= startOfDay(reference) - days.

branches.effect: return series unfiltered; else filtered

units.does: Replays the Banister EWMA: `archive`'s workouts merged with the HealthKit workouts → daily load from firstDay (today - lookbackDays) to today via TrainingLoadSeries.dailyLoad → replay → DaySample per day with trimp = that day's load.

branches.effect: firstDay = today (one-day series)
trimp = 0

units.does: Reads `archive`'s workouts for the window (lightweight retrieve) and merges them with the HealthKit workouts archive-authoritatively.

Sets lastUpdated = nil so the next needsRebuild returns true. Its one caller is invalidateIfWorkoutsChanged (archive write that changed the workouts); no HealthKit observer calls it — another app's workout arrives via the unchangedMaxAgeSec age-out.

Delete All My Data: cancels and drops the refresh and historical-series tasks, clears historicalBuildPending and lastHistoricalKey (so a late series build is not adopted), current, dailySeries, lastUpdated, computedAt and the workout fingerprint / computed day / load settings markers; then (when the cache has a persistenceURL) chains a detached utility task after the last persist task that removes that file if it exists (failure logged through attempt).

branches.effect: returns after clearing memory

branches.effect: nothing to remove

Starts a refresh task directly (not via refresh()) when none is in flight and HealthKit is configured.
